messages:
Nora (CSM): Hi all — kicking off Kelp's onboarding. Core objectives: secure SSO, PII handling for support transcripts, and a pilot chat flow with rollout criteria.
Omar (Kelp - ML): Thanks Nora. Our success metric is F1 > 0.86 on the triage intents suite, and we need session p95 < 350ms.
Priya (Solutions): I'll map integration steps and supply a demo repo. Question: are you planning cross-account users or single-tenant?
Omar (Kelp - ML): single-tenant for now. We'll revisit multi-tenant after pilot.
Ben (Platform Eng): On SSO: we support SAML and OIDC. If they're using IdP-initiated SAML, we'll need metadata + cert. Plan 10 business days for full verification.
Nora (CSM): tentative timeline suggestion: Week 0 - paperwork + SSO creds, Week 1-2 - integration + sample data upload, Week 3 - pilot, Week 4 - evaluation and handoff.
Priya (Solutions): sample SDK snippet for streaming responses (will drop into repo):
```
const stream = await redwood.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-vicuna', input: prompt });
for await (const p of stream) console.log(p.delta);
```
I'll add retry/backoff patterns and a small harness.
AuditBot: Reminder: security questionnaire not completed. Link: https://redwood.co/sec/q/kelp
Nora (CSM): Action items: - Omar: share IdP metadata + security point of contact (by Tue) - Priya: demo repo + integration checklist (by Wed) - Ben: SSO verification runbook + estimated maintenance windows (by Wed) - Nora: onboarding playbook + weekly standup invite (today).
Omar (Kelp - ML): I'll send metadata and a sanitized transcript sample today. Prefer weekly sync Thu 11AM PT.
Ben (Platform Eng): We'll enable KV cache recommendation for chat and propose quantization if model size necessitates cost savings.
Priya (Solutions): Noted. Also we'll instrument a small eval harness to validate F1 on canary prompts during pilot.
Nora (CSM): Great — I'll post a compact kickoff doc and the ownership board. If any risk (renewal or security) emerges flag it here. :white_check_mark:
